lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately eight visible vertical columns posterior to the gills, with spot diameter increasing along the longitudinal axis.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the primary circular blobs, forming a series of grid-like anchor nodes across the mid-flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A dominant horizontal linear ridge is visible on the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical intensity gradient with illumination on the dorsal edge and shadow on the ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin exhibits a low-density distribution of approximately 6-8 discrete high-luminance blobs contained within its visible silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: The cranial region displays a high-density micro-stippling pattern of very small spots that transition into the larger, more widely spaced macro-spots of the lateral flank.
